record.name: Guidance
record.narrative: You empower your allies to grant tactical advantages. The power manifests as empowering energy, tactical focus, creating a moment of empowering determination.
record.flavor_text: There is no emotion, there is peace.

manifestation.description: clear, forceful gesture extending telekinetic energy
visualizing the desired effect and channeling Force energy

base_effect.description: You touch one willing creature and grant them divine guidance for a brief moment.

mechanics.notes: Target gains advantage on their next ability check

class_synergies.narrative: Guardian naturally embodies Guidance's essence, channeling manipulating the Force to achieve the impossible with instinctive grace. Their protection philosophy aligns perfectly with Guidance's purpose, allowing them to vibrating air with enhanced compassionate determination.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians gain +1 to Force power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to quickly master new powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Jedi Order teaches the proper use of Force powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi gain +2 to Force power saving throw DCs.
